انقبضا (form VII)
# اِنْقَبَضَا (inqabaḍā) /in.qa.ba.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# اِنْقَبِضَا (inqabiḍā) /in.qa.bi.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
